scope.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17.6; exact canonical compute migration chain; minimal orgs fixture and Supabase API roles/default ACLs.
scope.service_role: Actual BYPASSRLS role, with SET LOCAL ROLE exercised against SQL grants.
scope.full_reset: Not run locally. Dedicated CI rebuilds all canonical migrations plus the exact replay overlay and runs --from-reset without base-object stubs. Guard compares exact (version,name) rows from resetMigrationPlan; local plan validation reports 468 = 384 production + 84 replay-only foundations. Approval readiness still requires CI.
scope.staging: Real Core gateway and node-agent processes; local PostgREST fixture and synthetic executor/identity. No production connection, device inference or provider calls.
scope.not_run: Optional --full hard-disconnect case; full Core suite; hosted Supabase full reset.
scope.evidence_boundary: Direct service-role mutations of attestation rows are denied. Existing parent foreign-key cascade behavior and privileged database administration are unchanged; this is not a tamper-proof ledger. Cryptographic verification remains the Core gateway/receipt responsibility.

steps.name: preflight: gateway health and receipt key
authorization: admin routes refuse a missing or wrong token; enrolment refuses a wrong token; an unknown key is refused
enrolment and capability reporting: the real node agent enrols over TLS and advertises ai.chat/fixture.echo.local
submit: idempotent per key, conflict on a different body under the same key, refusal when no live node serves the capability
status, result and signed receipt: the fixture node leases, runs and completes the job; the receipt verifies offline
duplicate results are rejected: same payload replays idempotently, a different payload is refused, a replayed nonce is refused, a late failure cannot undo a commit
disconnect and retry: an injected executor failure fails the lease, the task requeues with backoff and the second attempt completes
revocation: a revoked node is refused on its next signed request and the fabric no longer offers its capability
pending SQL hygiene: populated evidence blocks rollback; an empty fixture rolls back and re-applies

gateway_proof.after_proof_edits: Only support-only source-map context comments were added after the successful 10/10 native gateway run.

readiness: D has its service-role default ACL leak fixed. E forward SQL behavior is unchanged apart from its source-map context comments. D/E rollback files refuse any populated state and require READ COMMITTED, holding an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock across the empty check and drops with a five-second lock timeout. Each production application remains subject to exact-file approval and full-reset CI.
rollback: Only an unused empty installation may be removed. Keep signed attestations and all scheduler rows, including expired/released history, after application rollback. Refusal is SQLSTATE 55000. No destructive override or production data deletion is provided.
source_map_context: Equity Uprise shared-platform support-only evidence for existing Core compute persistence; no building capability ownership or activation.
